[LIMP.3.3.1] The reference compiler ships with a bundled
set of `.ds` library files: the standard library, `units.core` ([LUNI.4.1.2])
and the canonical adapters' libraries among them.
These resolve through the same search path as integrator-
installed adapters; the bundle is one entry on the
search path, after every entry the invocation names.

**The bundle is always there.** It ships as `.ds`
files, and the compiler **must not** carry their content compiled in. Every
build of the compiler **must** find the bundle where [RCLI.1.11] puts it, with
nothing for an author, an integrator or a developer to set up, so one compiler
accepts the same programs wherever it runs.
